info.name: Vio Backend API (v2 direct cut — full SDK inventory)
info.description:
Every HTTP request exchanged in the Apple TV → iOS cart-intent v2 flow. Ordered by execution sequence per SDK.

**Surfaces**:
- `/v2/tv/*` — Apple TV SDK (folder 1)
- `/v2/mobile/*` — iOS SDK (folder 2)
- `/v2/commerce/*` — per-sponsor catalog (folder 3, also in 2.D)
- `/v2/admin/*` — platform admin (folder 4)
- `/api/*` — dashboard operator (folder 5)
- `{{mockUrl}}` — partner outbound contract (folder 6)
- WebSocket — documented in folder 7 (not runnable in Postman)

**Legacy v1** endpoints still hit by iOS today (`/v1/sdk/campaigns`, `/v1/sdk/config`, `/v1/campaigns/:id/config`, `/v1/engagement/config`, `/v1/localization/:lang`, `/v1/offers`, `/v1/sdk/broadcast`, `/v1/sdk/broadcasts/:id/lineup`, `/api/campaigns/:id/active-components`) are inline in folder 2 with **LEGACY active** tag. They run in the live demo but await v2 migration.

Each request's description documents Purpose / Called by (exact Swift file:line) / Expected response / Pre-conditions.

item.name: 0. Setup & Health
item.description: Basic reachability + connectivity pre-flight for the local dev backend + tunnel + partner mock.

request.description:
**Purpose**: Backend health check.

**Called by**: Anyone.

**Expected**: 200 `{status:"ok", timestamp}`

item.name: 1. Apple TV SDK — runtime flow (execution order)
item.description:
Exact HTTP request sequence the Apple TV SDK (`VioTVManager`, InteractiveAds-vio branch `feature/api-v2-urls`) executes. All require `X-API-Key: {{apiKey}}` (TV2 clientApp key).

Note: the WebSocket at `wss://<host>/ws/<campaignId>` is opened by the SDK after 1.1 succeeds (via `wsUrl` in the response). Identify frame `{type:"identify",userId}` is sent over WS, not HTTP — see folder 7 for WS reference.

request.description:
**Purpose**: Combined TV bootstrap — validates broadcast ownership, ensures `end_users` + upserts `tv_sessions`, returns campaign + sponsors + wsUrl + capabilities.

**Called by**: `VioTVManager.subscribe` (Sources/VioTVCore/VioTVManager.swift:143). Fires on `VioTV.connect(broadcastId:)` from TVPlayerView.onAppear.

**Expected**: 200 `{subscribed:true, campaignId:36, broadcastId, sessionId, endUserId, wsUrl:"wss://…/ws/36", primarySponsor:{id,name,commerce:{apiKey,…}}, secondarySponsors:[…], capabilities:{shoppable:true, engagement:<bool>}}`

**Pre-conditions**: `broadcastId` exists + campaign.primarySponsorId set + clientApp.tv_enabled + platform in tv_platforms.

**Purpose**: Validates the soft-miss path — broadcast not registered for this clientApp.

**Called by**: BroadcastPickerView "Broadcast desconocido" option tests this.

**Expected**: 200 `{subscribed:false, reason:"broadcast_not_registered_for_client_app"}`. Other reasons: `campaign_has_no_primary_sponsor`, `tv_not_enabled_for_this_platform`.

**Purpose**: **NOT a REST call** — runtime opens a WebSocket to the `wsUrl` returned by 1.1. First frame after handshake is `{"type":"identify","userId":"<externalUserId>"}`. SDK then listens for `shoppable_ad`, `cart_intent`, `component_status_changed`.

**Called by**: `VioTVWebSocketManager.connect` (Sources/VioTVCore/Managers/VioTVWebSocketManager.swift:11).

**Expected**: Postman cannot really test WS upgrade — this row is informational. For live WS inspection use the browser devtools on the dashboard or `wscat -c wss://api-local-angelo.vio.live/ws/36`.

**Purpose**: Keeps `tv_sessions.last_seen_at` fresh.

**Called by**: `VioTVSessionManager.sendHeartbeat` (Sources/VioTVCore/Managers/VioTVSessionManager.swift:39), fires every 60s from a background Task spawned by 1.1.

**Expected**: 200 `{ok:true, lastSeenAt:"<ISO>"}`

**Pre-conditions**: `sessionId` returned by 1.1.

**Purpose**: Dispatches a shoppable ad (source=tv-sdk). Persists `shoppable_ad_activations` and broadcasts WS `shoppable_ad` to campaign subscribers.

**Called by**: Used by automation + the smoke-test dispatcher. **This is what the curl step fires during Phase 5 smoke test.**

**Expected**: 200 `{success:true, activationId:<int>, product, sponsor}` + WS `shoppable_ad` event to `/ws/36`.

**Pre-conditions**: Sponsor must have `avatar_url` set (422 `SPONSOR_MISSING_AVATAR` otherwise).

**Purpose**: TV-originated cart intent with v2 minimal body. Backend persists `cart_intents` + forwards envelope to mobile user (WS direct → webhook/APNs fallback).

**Called by**: `VioTVManager.sendCartIntent` (Sources/VioTVCore/VioTVManager.swift:88).

**Expected**: 200 `{success:true, cartIntentId, deliveryMode:"websocket"|"dual"|"webhook"|"apns"|"dropped"}`. Fires WS `cart_intent` to the iOS app if connected.

**Pre-conditions**: `activationId` must exist in `shoppable_ad_activations`.

**Purpose**: Marks the TV session as ended.

**Called by**: `VioTVSessionManager.sendEnd` (Sources/VioTVCore/Managers/VioTVSessionManager.swift:43) on `VioTV.disconnect()`.

**Expected**: 200 `{ok:true, endedAt:"<ISO>"}`

**Purpose**: Standalone session creation without subscribing. **Not called by the reference Apple TV demo** — subscribe (1.1) already creates the session. Kept as a building block for automation / custom hosts.

**Called by**: Automation only.

**Expected**: 200 `{sessionId, endUserId, startedAt}`

item.name: 2. iOS Mobile SDK — runtime flow (execution order)
item.description:
Exact HTTP requests the iOS SDK (VioSwiftSDK branch `feature/api-v2-urls`) issues during a normal app session. Grouped by phase. All require `X-API-Key: {{apiKey}}` — for the TV2 demo this is the same `tv2_api_key_91b4fbf634af4bc5`.

The "Legacy v1" rows are still actively called by the current SDK (pending a v2 migration). They're listed in call order, not separated into a "deprecated" folder, because they run in the live demo today.

request.description:
**Purpose**: First call on app launch. Returns campaigns + components bound to this clientApp for zero-config bootstrap.

**Called by**: `CampaignManager.discoverCampaigns` (Sources/VioCore/Managers/CampaignManager.swift:1082). Fires from ContentView.onAppear + TV2VideoPlayer.onAppear.

**Expected**: 200 `{campaigns:[{campaignId,campaignName,isActive,components:[…]}]}`

**Purpose**: Fallback commerce bootstrap. Older v1 shape — superseded by 2.A3.

**Called by**: CampaignManager.swift:816 fallback path, triggered when v2 bootstrap fails.

**Expected**: 200 v1 shape `{campaign,commerce:{apiKey,endpoint}, theme:{…}}`

**Purpose**: Multi-sponsor commerce bootstrap. Returns primary + secondaries + per-sponsor commerce blocks + paymentMethods.

**Called by**: `CampaignManager.bootstrapCommerceFromSdkConfig` (Sources/VioCore/Managers/CampaignManager.swift:712).

**Expected**: 200 `{endpoints, campaign, primarySponsor:{commerce:{apiKey,paymentMethods}}, secondarySponsors:[…], features}`

**Purpose**: Full campaign config: brand, theme, checkout, features.

**Called by**: `ConfigAPIClient.fetchCampaignConfig` (Sources/VioCore/Network/ConfigAPIClient.swift:20).

**Expected**: 200 `{campaignId, brand:{name,logoUrl,iconUrl}, ui:{theme}, features:{enablePolls,…}, checkout:{paymentMethods}}`

**Purpose**: Engagement-specific config for a broadcast.

**Called by**: `ConfigAPIClient.fetchEngagementConfig` (Sources/VioCore/Network/ConfigAPIClient.swift:64).

**Expected**: 200 `{engagement:{demoMode,defaultPollDuration,defaultContestDuration}}`

**Purpose**: UI translations for the SDK (languages: no, en, sv, es, de, fr, da, fi).

**Called by**: `ConfigAPIClient.fetchLocalization` (Sources/VioCore/Network/ConfigAPIClient.swift:107).

**Expected**: 200 `{language, translations:{key:value}, dateFormat, timeFormat}`

**Purpose**: Returns banner offers for a campaign.

**Called by**: `CampaignManager.fetchOffers` (Sources/VioCore/Managers/CampaignManager.swift:1369).

**Expected**: 200 `{campaignId, offers:[{id,type:"banner",config}]}`

**Purpose**: Legacy active-components endpoint used by the offer-banner subsystem (alternative to WS-based discovery).

**Called by**: `OfferBannerViewModel.fetchActiveComponents` (Sources/VioCore/Models/OfferBannerModels.swift:567).

**Expected**: 200 `[{instanceId,componentId,locationId,type,config,status}]`

**Purpose**: **NOT a REST call**. iOS opens a WebSocket to `{wsBase}/ws/:campaignId` and sends `{"type":"identify","userId":"<externalUserId>"}` as first frame.

**Called by**: `CampaignWebSocketManager.connect` (Sources/VioCore/Managers/CampaignWebSocketManager.swift).

**Expected**: Events received: cart_intent, shoppable_ad, component_status_changed, poll_activated, contest_activated, lineup_show, campaign_started/ended, broadcast_status_changed, ping. See folder 7 for WS reference.

**Purpose**: Feature flags per broadcast.

**Called by**: iOS SDK when opening a broadcast-scoped view.

**Expected**: 200 `{broadcastId, campaignId, engagement:{enabled,hasPolls,hasContests}, shoppable:{enabled}, lineup:{available}}`

**Purpose**: Active campaign_components + broadcast overrides, each with sponsor + commerce block.

**Called by**: 5 product views (VProductCarousel, VProductSpotlight, VProductStore, VProductBanner, VProductSlider).

**Expected**: 200 `{broadcastId, components:[{id, type, locationId, sponsor:{id,name,commerce:{apiKey}}, config:{productIds:[…]}}]}`

**Purpose**: Match lineup from Sportmonks.

**Called by**: `LineupService.fetchLineup` (Sources/VioCastingUI/Managers/Match/LineupService.swift:58).

**Expected**: 200 lineup structure.

**Purpose**: Resolves partner-internal `contentId` → Vio `broadcastId`. Used by Viaplay flow, not by the TV2 demo.

**Called by**: `BroadcastValidationService.validateContentId` (Sources/VioCore/Services/BroadcastValidationService.swift:24).

**Expected**: 200 `{hasEngagement, broadcastId, broadcastName, status, campaignId, websocketChannel, broadcastComponents:{polls,contests}}`

**Purpose**: Active polls for a broadcast.

**Called by**: `BackendEngagementRepository.fetchActivePolls` (Sources/VioEngagementSystem/Data/BackendEngagementRepository.swift).

**Expected**: 200 `{polls:[{id,question,options:[{id,text,voteCount,percentage}],duration,isActive}], pagination:{limit,offset,total,hasMore}}`

**Purpose**: Cast a vote.

**Called by**: `BackendEngagementRepository.vote`.

**Expected**: 200 `{success:true, results:{totalVotes, options:[…]}}`. 429 if rate-limited.

**Purpose**: Active contests for a broadcast.

**Called by**: `BackendEngagementRepository.fetchActiveContests`.

**Expected**: 200 `{contests:[{id,title,prize,isActive}], pagination}`

**Purpose**: Submit contest entry.

**Called by**: `BackendEngagementRepository.participate`.

**Expected**: 200 `{success:true}`. 429 if rate-limited.

**Purpose**: Sponsor-scoped catalog (Vio-side proxy over Commerce GraphQL).

**Called by**: `CommerceSdkClientProvider.client(forSponsorId:)` → `ProductService.loadProduct(sponsorId:)` (Sources/VioUI/Services/ProductService.swift:46).

**Expected**: 200 `{sponsorId, products:[{id,name,price,currency,imageUrl,images[…]}]}`

**Purpose**: Raw Commerce GraphQL proxy. Prefer 2.D1 in runtime.

**Called by**: Debug.

**Expected**: 200 `{products:[…]}`

**Purpose**: **Different host** — iOS SDK also calls the Commerce GraphQL endpoint DIRECTLY for product load (not proxied through Vio backend). Uses the sponsor's commerce_api_key from 2.A3.

**Called by**: `CommerceSdkClientProvider` configured GraphQL client (Sources/VioUI/Services/ProductService.swift + VioCore/Configuration/ConfigurationLoader.swift:309).

**Expected**: 200 with products. Returns 401 if commerce_api_key revoked; iOS falls back to re-fetching 2.A3 via `runWithCommerceAuthRetry`.

**Purpose**: Mobile-originated cart intent (in-app tap, not TV-originated).

**Called by**: `VioCampaignPartnerAPI.sendCartIntent` (Sources/VioCore/Network/VioCampaignPartnerAPI.swift:27).

**Expected**: 200 `{ok:true, cartIntentId, deliveryMode}`

**Purpose**: Registers APNs/FCM token. Backend also forwards to partner's `partnerDeviceRegisterUrl` if set (see folder 6.2).

**Called by**: `VioCampaignPartnerAPI.registerDevice` (Sources/VioCore/Network/VioCampaignPartnerAPI.swift:70) via `CampaignManager.submitApnsDeviceTokenForVioRegister`.

**Expected**: 200 `{success:true}`. Also fires outbound POST to partner mock.

item.name: 6. Partner outbound (mock server)
item.description: Endpoints the **partner** hosts; Vio calls outbound. Today the Azure mock at `{{mockUrl}}` implements them. HMAC signing is documented in `docs/API_V2_CONTRACT.md §8` but deferred.

request.description:
**Purpose**: Canonical cart_intent envelope Vio POSTs to partner when the mobile user is offline on WS.

**Called by**: Vio backend `notifyCartIntentPartnerFallback` (server/routes.ts) when `deliveryMode in {webhook, dual}`.

**Expected**: 200 `{status:"success", message:"Webhook processed", devices_notified:<n>}` (cold start ~3s).

**Purpose**: Vio forwards APNs/FCM token to partner after 2.E2.

**Called by**: Vio backend after mobile `register-device` if clientApp has `partnerDeviceRegisterUrl`.

**Expected**: 200 text `"Device registered"`.

item.name: 7. WebSocket events (reference — not runnable in Postman)
item.description:
WebSocket at `wss://<host>/ws/:campaignId`. iOS + Apple TV both connect here; backend fans out events per connected campaign.

NOT directly runnable via Postman (WS support is limited). Use `wscat -c wss://api-local-angelo.vio.live/ws/36` in a terminal and send `{"type":"identify","userId":"demo_user_001"}` as first frame to observe inbound events.

**Server → client events**:
- `shoppable_ad` — TV dispatch landed (carries activationId, sponsorId, product, sponsor)
- `cart_intent` — user-scoped cart-intent envelope (canonical v1 shape)
- `component_status_changed` — placement toggled active/inactive (carries sponsorId at root)
- `poll_activated` / `poll_deactivated` / `poll_results_updated`
- `contest_activated` / `contest_deactivated`
- `lineup_show`
- `campaign_started` / `campaign_ended`
- `broadcast_status_changed`
- `ping` (every 30s; client must respond `{"type":"pong"}`)

**Client → server frames**:
- `{"type":"identify","userId":"<externalUserId>"}` — first frame, required for user-scoped routing
- `{"type":"pong"}` — reply to ping

Dedup rules: iOS dedups cart_intent by `activationId` in `CampaignManager.publishCartIntentIfChanged` (VioSwiftSDK).
